text_en: For now the Sovereign, the Lord of hosts, is taking away from Jerusalem and from Judah support and staff— all support of bread, and all support of water—
text_cn: 看啊！主，万军的上主，将夺去耶路撒冷和犹大的支柱和依靠，【各种食粮的供应和水的供应：】

text_en: warrior and soldier, judge and prophet, diviner and elder,
text_cn: 勇将和战士，判官和先知，占卜者和长老，

text_en: captain of fifty and dignitary, counselor and skillful magician and expert enchanter.
text_cn: 五十夫长和显贵，谋士、机警的术士和巧言的咒师。

text_en: And I will make boys their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
text_cn: 他将使青年人作他们的首领，使顽童管治他们；

text_en: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another and everyone by a neighbor; the youth will be insolent to the elder, and the base to the honorable.
text_cn: 百姓将互相压榨，彼此残害；幼童欺凌老翁，贱者虐待贵人。

text_en: Someone will even seize a relative, a member of the clan, saying, “You have a cloak; you shall be our leader, and this heap of ruins shall be under your rule. ”
text_cn: 那时，人要抓住自己家族里的一个弟兄说：“你还有一件外衣，你可作我们的领袖，这废墟即属于你手下。”

text_en: But the other will cry out on that day, saying, “I will not be a healer; in my house there is neither bread nor cloak; you shall not make me leader of the people. ”
text_cn: 那一日，这人必要大声回答说：“我不是个医生，我家里没有粮食，也没有外衣，不要立我作百姓的首领！”

text_en: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen, because their speech and their deeds are against the Lord , defying his glorious presence.
text_cn: 耶路撒冷倾覆了，犹大崩溃了，因为他们的口舌和行为都与上主作对，使他光辉的眼目冒火。

text_en: The look on their faces bears witness against them; they proclaim their sin like Sodom, they do not hide it. Woe to them! For they have brought evil on themselves.
text_cn: 他们的厚颜已在指责他们，他们像索多玛人一样揭示了自己的邪恶，而毫不隐瞒；这些人是有祸的，因为他们为自己招致了灾祸。

text_en: Tell the innocent how fortunate they are, for they shall eat the fruit of their labors.
text_cn: 你们要说：“义人是有福的，因为他们必享受自己行为的善果。

text_en: Woe to the guilty! How unfortunate they are, for what their hands have done shall be done to them.
text_cn: 祸哉作恶的人！他必遭灾祸，因为他手中的作为必回报于他！”

text_en: My people—children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, your leaders mislead you, and confuse the course of your paths.
text_cn: 至于我的百姓：孩童要压榨他们，妇女要管辖他们。我的百姓啊！领导你的，领你走错了路，混乱了你行径的路途。

text_en: The Lord rises to argue his case; he stands to judge the peoples.
text_cn: 上主要站起来审判，立着审判他的百姓。

text_en: The Lord enters into judgment with the elders and princes of his people: It is you who have devoured the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
text_cn: 上主要开庭审讯他百姓的长老和领袖：“是你们侵吞了我的葡萄园， 窝藏了由穷人那里勒索来的物件；

text_en: What do you mean by crushing my people, by grinding the face of the poor? says the Lord God of hosts.
text_cn: 你们为什么压榨我的百姓，折磨穷人的脸面？”──吾主，万军上主的断语。

text_en: The Lord said: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty and walk with outstretched necks, glancing wantonly with their eyes, mincing along as they go, tinkling with their feet;
text_cn: 上主说：因为熙雍的女子趾高气扬，走路挺直颈项，媚眼惑人，行路装腔作势，脚步铃铃作响，

text_en: the Lord will afflict with scabs the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will lay bare their secret parts.
text_cn: 吾主必使熙雍女子的头顶生长毒疮，上主必揭露她们的耻辱。

text_en: In that day the Lord will take away the finery of the anklets, the headbands, and the crescents;
text_cn: 那一日，吾主必要剥夺她们的妆饰：踝环、圆环、月牙环、

text_en: the pendants, the bracelets, and the scarfs;
text_cn: 耳环、手镯和面纱，

text_en: the headdresses, the armlets, the sashes, the perfume boxes, and the amulets;
text_cn: 帽巾、脚链、领带、香盒、符籐、

text_en: the signet rings and nose rings;
text_cn: 戒指、鼻环、

text_en: the festal robes, the mantles, the cloaks, and the handbags;
text_cn: 礼服、斗蓬、披肩、手袋、

text_en: the garments of gauze, the linen garments, the turbans, and the veils.
text_cn: 面罩、衬衫、头巾和夏衣。

text_en: Instead of perfume there will be a stench; and instead of a sash, a rope; and instead of well-set hair, baldness; and instead of a rich robe, a binding of sackcloth; instead of beauty, shame.
text_cn: 必有腥臭代替馨香，绳索代替腰带，秃头代替发髻，苦衣代替胸衣，烙印代替美丽。

text_en: Your men shall fall by the sword and your warriors in battle.
text_cn: 你的男丁要倒于刀下，你的勇士要死于战场！

text_en: And her gates shall lament and mourn; ravaged, she shall sit upon the ground.
text_cn: 熙雍的城门将恸（tòng）哭哀悼，熙雍将凄凉地坐在地上。
